title: Finite groundwater storage and reciprocal two-store exchange
purpose: Replace the externally fixed groundwater head with a finite linear groundwater storage and qualify reciprocal exchange, shared-state conservation, and stiff temporal behavior before management is reintroduced.

physical_system.exclusions: no management, recharge, routing, external drainage, or physical datum crossing in DUMMY-09

continuous.interpretation: heads approach but do not cross

experiments.G1: one trapezoid exchange volume is exactly reciprocal: surface storage loss equals groundwater storage gain
experiments.G2: total two-store water is invariant for continuous oracle and every discrete accepted step
experiments.G3: continuous oracle preserves weighted equilibrium and decays head difference monotonically without sign reversal
experiments.G4: trapezoid closed-form V and updated heads satisfy both discrete storage equations and trapezoidal exchange equation
experiments.G5: observed discrete head-difference amplification equals g=(1-mu)/(1+mu) for unequal as well as equal storage coefficients
experiments.G6: mu<1 preserves head ordering, mu=1 lands at equal heads in one discrete step, and mu>1 reverses head ordering
experiments.G7: canonical mu=1.5 repeated trapezoid steps alternate head ordering with geometrically decaying difference while conserving total storage
experiments.G8: partitioning the canonical horizon into sufficiently fine substeps removes sign reversal and approaches the exact continuous end heads

interpretation_rules: A_g is an equivalent linear groundwater storage coefficient, not a claim of MODFLOW cell storage formulation
head-order reversal at mu>1 is a temporal-discretization artifact of the frozen trapezoidal two-store model, not a mass-balance failure
mu is distinct from the DUMMY-04 one-sided lambda because both storage responses now enter the shared exchange mode
no management priority is present in DUMMY-09
forbidden: no inference that trapezoidal integration is the production scheme
